title: A rigorously characterized I3322 quantum wall, spatial attainment, and finite-dimensional nonattainment
description: The tensor-product and commuting-operator suprema of the canonical I3322 Bell functional are identified with a rigorously characterized domain-wall constant. A normal spatial strategy on ell^2(Z) tensor ell^2(Z) attains the value, while no finite-dimensional strategy does, proving C_q(3,3;2,2) != C_qs(3,3;2,2) and nonclosure of C_q. A Jordan--Schmidt--Caratheodory argument makes the 3-by-3 scenario minimal by bipartite binary input counts. The release includes independent interval and symbolic reconstructions.
